items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: we had this particular man, Aaron Long, I forgot to tell you. He booked us on a trip, he gave up his market, and booked us on a trip from Pensacola to Jacksonville.

ctx.x: well we didn't leave yo no with no bass that's what we left yo with so when we got there I'm gonna tell you how the band formed up we found out that Joe Wynn had been working for a guy color color named Morris which had an undertaker and he had been hiring bands over there but he was crooked with that band Joe Wynn broke away from him and got with a doctor I think the doctor was named Dr. Brunwick or something colored doctor and there was another man colored man named Aaron Long he had a meat market and Aaron…
